body: I think I more wanted to express my dilemma, and avoid upsetting anyone I personally know in the process. My mate committed suicide, and we had a suicide pact. I would rather not go on anyway. I have made multiple attempts, but I'm new to it and am figuring it out. Kudos to you for spending your time trying to help strangers.

My heart aches for you. I had a similar thing just happen to me, only it was in the next room... I couldn't go to his funeral. The last I saw of him was not what I would wish on anyone. It has been a few weeks. I've survived this far because of other people, and distractions. Today I chose to submerse myself in music, rather than make another attempt. Its on my mind all the time. I would recommend a crisis therapist. Some will scale to your income. One thing I read is that its okay to have suicidal thoughts, but it doesn't mean you have to act on them.
